Carmen CS: quick check-in for OrchardEdge private/VPC onboarding 1: scope = network egress to Sumo Logic, IAM trust for our log-writer role, KMS/HSM policy update, and audit log delivery. Renewal flagged concern if audit delivery not validated by EOW. What are blockers?
Liam (OrchardEdge): main blockers: Sumo not receiving events; our ops sees TLS handshake and cert chain errors. Also waiting on the exact role ARN to add to our sidecar trust policy. KMS team wants confirmation that key will be usable with our external HSM.
Theo (Net): seeing SYN retries from the forwarder subnet to sumo collectors. Liam, can you DM collector IPs and whether Sumo expects mTLS or client cert thumbprint?
Liam (OrchardEdge): collectors: sumo-1.orchardedge.io (18.204.55.77) and sumo-2.orchardedge.io (18.204.55.78). They require mTLS; thumbprint will be sent via DM.
Theo (Net): I'll lock egress to those IPs and port 443 only. ETA ~15m. CLI snippet: ```gcloud compute firewall-rules update oe-logs-egress --destination-ranges 18.204.55.77/32,18.204.55.78/32 --allow tcp:443```
Ritika (SolutionsEng): IAM role to provide: arn:aws:iam::222333444555:role/orchard-log-writer. You'll need sts:AssumeRole from our logging principal. We'll also add a condition to the trust policy restricting external account.
Anya (Security): KMS/HSM note: if OrchardEdge uses an external HSM for key material, we must add a policy allowing decrypt/generate-data-key for the role arn and also annotate key usage with an EncryptionContext binding to the audit stream. Example policy stanza (redacted): {"Sid":"AllowOrchardLogging","Effect":"Allow","Principal":{"AWS":"arn:aws:iam::222333444555:role/orchard-log-writer"},"Action":["kms:Decrypt","kms:GenerateDataKey"],"Condition":{"StringEquals":{"kms:EncryptionContext:stream":"orchard-audit"}}} Apply to the CMK.
Ritika (SolutionsEng): propose key rotation window Wed 23:00 UTC (low traffic). Liam, can OrchardEdge accept that?
Liam (OrchardEdge): Wed 23:00 UTC OK. We'll pause ingestion for ~10m and re-run tests.
ci-bot: forwarder-deploy #4521 started -> status: running
Theo (Net): firewall changes applied, verified TCP 443 connect from fw-test instance to both collectors.
ci-bot: forwarder-deploy #4521 finished -> status: success, 0 errors
Liam (OrchardEdge): retried after KMS policy update and egress lock; now seeing 200s and a SLIM message: "{\"ts\":\"2026-03-23T04:12:05Z\",\"status\":200,\"msg\":\"accepted\"}"
Carmen CS: action items recap: 1) Theo applied egress to Sumo collectors. 2) Anya to drop final KMS JSON (ETA 2h). 3) Ritika to schedule rotation Wed 23:00 UTC and send invites. 4) Liam to paste post-rotation ingest sample. Renewal EOW 1: if audits + rotation not validated by Fri EOD escalate. I'll send a brief health snapshot tomorrow. :white_check_mark:
